# ToolRank

> Confused by AI? Editorial rankings of AI tools by use case. Last updated 2026-10-16. Rankings are editorial; featured placements are labelled. Launch offer: free for the first 100 tools (including featured placement); after that, free listing plus paid options at founding prices.

## Categories


Audiences: 'For You' (consumer and creator tools) and 'For Business' (B2B and developer tools). 269 tools ranked across 16 categories; 0 approved user reviews.

- [AI Assistants](https://toolrank.io/best/ai-assistants/): General-purpose AI chat assistants for everyday questions, writing and thinking. 6 tools; #1: ChatGPT.
- [Coding & App Building](https://toolrank.io/best/coding/): Build apps from a prompt, or code faster with AI pair programmers and agents. 53 tools; #1: Cursor.
- [Image & Design](https://toolrank.io/best/image/): Create and edit images, graphics and designs from prompts. 19 tools; #1: Midjourney.
- [Video & Animation](https://toolrank.io/best/video/): Generate, edit, caption and translate video with AI. 27 tools; #1: Runway.
- [Writing & Content](https://toolrank.io/best/writing/): Drafting, editing, rewriting and long-form writing. 11 tools; #1: Grammarly.
- [Voice & Audio](https://toolrank.io/best/voice-audio/): Speech, voice cloning, dictation, music and audio editing. 21 tools; #1: ElevenLabs.
- [Automation & Agents](https://toolrank.io/best/automation/): Automate workflows and build AI agents, no-code or in code. 29 tools; #1: Zapier.
- [Research & Productivity](https://toolrank.io/best/research/): Answer engines, research assistants, notes, meetings and planning. 29 tools; #1: Perplexity.
- [Marketing & Sales](https://toolrank.io/best/marketing/): Marketing copy, social content, prospecting and CRM AI. 7 tools; #1: Jasper.
- [Business & Data](https://toolrank.io/best/business/): AI for workplace suites, databases, meetings and enterprise teams. 9 tools; #1: Microsoft 365 Copilot.
- [Restaurants & Bars](https://toolrank.io/best/restaurants/): AI phone hosts, voice ordering, marketing and kitchen waste tracking for venues. 7 tools; #1: Slang.ai.
- [Hospitality & Travel](https://toolrank.io/best/hospitality/): AI trip planners for travellers and guest-messaging and revenue AI for hotels. 7 tools; #1: Mindtrip.
- [Crypto & Web3](https://toolrank.io/best/crypto/): On-chain research, AI trading assistants, wallet security, portfolio and tax tools. 25 tools; #1: Nansen.
- [Education & Learning](https://toolrank.io/best/education/): AI tutors, language learning and classroom tools for teachers. 6 tools; #1: Khanmigo.
- [Health & Fitness](https://toolrank.io/best/health/): AI workout coaching, sleep and recovery insights, symptom checks and wellbeing. 6 tools; #1: Fitbod.
- [Gaming](https://toolrank.io/best/gaming/): Make games and game assets with AI, or play AI-driven stories. 7 tools; #1: Rosebud AI.
